descripcion: A straight seawall and coastal avenue run along the S part of the circle with surf at its base, and no outfall or channel opening is visible.
Shoreline along the NE part of the circle is a ruined quay with rubble and old dock frames, and no pipe, channel or creek reaches the water.
Harbour piers and docked ships fill the N half of the circle, and the visible quay edges show no pipe, culvert or channel.
A narrow dark channel or creek between the rocky headland and the eastern grounds enters the bay at the NE part of the circle.
Tree-lined curved beach along the SW and S edge of the circle shows no visible creek mouth or outfall, though overhanging trees could hide a small one.
Shipyard quays and a floating dock in the E/SE part of the circle show no visible pipe, drain or channel, though turbid water lies to the W.
A dark coastal pond or lagoon in the W-centre of the circle appears to open to the sea through a gap in the rocky shore near the W edge.
A river or canal running SW to NE along the W side of the circle opens into the bay inside the circle, with a lighter turbid plume.
Rocky reef flat and beach run along the SE half of the circle; the dark patches in the shallows look like seabed, not a discharge structure.
Rocky shoreline with surf crosses the circle from SW to E, and no channel, drain or stream mouth is visible.
